description: Outcome only, for the lift: the bulk discount works end to end (hidden outcome tests pass, Do-not-touch kept, settings in PricingOptions, changes only in src and tests). The Tandem arm runs the whole feature lane (/spec drafts spec, plan and tasks; the script approves the one gate); the baseline arm gets the same work item as one plain prompt.

baseline.prompt: Implement this in the sample-api repo (you are on its branch dev/feature/L1-bulk-discount). Customers who order a lot should pay less. Orders with 10 or more items in total (adding up the quantity on every line) get 5% off the subtotal. Smaller orders are priced as today. Sales expects to change the threshold and the rate later. Acceptance criteria: an order with 10 or more items in total gets 5% off its subtotal; an order with fewer than 10 items is priced as today; the threshold and the rate can be changed in one place without touching the pricing rule. Add tests, make sure every test passes, and commit. Nobody is watching: do not ask questions, make reasonable choices and finish.
